name: NeMF (Neural Microflake Field)
definition: A volume rendering method representing a scene as a distribution of microflakes at every point in space, enabling inverse rendering by modeling light transportation via microflake normals and roughness, unlike standard NeRF which only models view-dependent radiance.
summary: NeMF is a differentiable inverse volume rendering method that recovers physical attributes by modeling light transportation via microflake normals and roughness, handling complex geometry and translucency better than standard NeRF.
